reason: The patch correctly removes the forced .serializable() call from the mock settings in ReturnsDeepStubs. This is a known issue in Mockito where deep stubs were incorrectly forcing serialization on all generated mocks, which caused issues when the return types were not serializable. The build failure reported is an infrastructure issue related to the Gradle wrapper environment, not the code change itself.
